column1: # --- heating modes (the Värme page). Hemma, Sova and Borta give each room a planned temperature (<room>_plan), which a rule copies
# into the room's target when it changes; the target can still be changed by hand or on a thermostat until the plan changes again.
# heat_mode = auto follows the schedule; a mode chosen by hand holds until Schema (auto) is chosen again. manual (chosen on the page or a target
# changed in the UI) and manual_until_switch (a setpoint changed on a thermostat) leave the targets alone (the plans still follow the schedule):
# manual until a mode or Schema is chosen, manual_until_switch until the schedule's next switch. Leaving either applies the plans at once. Around each switch of the
# schedule the modes on both sides count for heat_overlap, and the warmer wins: a room that gets warmer starts early, one that gets colder waits;
# during that overlap heat_overlap_slack degrees below the warmer mode is enough.
